title: Collapse Boolean compatibility projection onto the canonical relation compiler

masterplan.active_gate: Gate 1 — Renovation, owner-directed Genesis and general computer assistance

scope: Delete the duplicate Forest/Fourfold Boolean projection implementation and preserve boolean_relation_block_from_fourfold only as a thin compatibility shim over compile_relation_blocks(..., BooleanSemiring(), signatures=(signature,)); retain only diagnostic wording compatibility and move the empty-retention canonical_sha regression to the canonical compiler owner.

changes: boolean_relation_block_from_fourfold now delegates one explicit signature to compile_relation_blocks with BooleanSemiring and returns the canonical compiled block.

Duplicate node partition, endpoint completeness, binding admission, Forest hyperedge/edge scans, retention hashing, index construction and TypedRelationBlock materialization were deleted from relation_projection.py.
Only legacy error-string translations remain in the compatibility shim; they change diagnostics only and do not decide admission or manufacture facts.
The empty-retention hash guard now monkeypatches daedalus.twin.relation_compiler.canonical_sha, making the canonical compiler the explicit hashing owner.
No helper, cache, registry, graph authority, projector, backend, public API, fact store or parallel abstraction was introduced.

focused_regressions: the existing strict Boolean projection surface continues through the canonical compiler for same-plane and verified cross-plane relations
legacy exact-Forest, invalid-signature, undirected-edge, missing-binding and cross-plane-hyperedge diagnostics remain translated without duplicating admission logic
empty same-plane Fourfold retention still avoids Forest relation hashing, now asserted against relation_compiler.canonical_sha

verification.contract_matrix: Python 3.10/3.12 x PYTHONHASHSEED 0/123456 workflow completed successfully
verification.diagnostic_profiles: CPU bitset and TypedRelationBlock validation remain diagnostic-only; no superiority claim
verification.tauri_preceding_steps: cockpit build, frozen backend build/smoke, project/desktop contract tests and icon generation succeeded before the formatting failure

bounded_next_step: GPU-72 only: audit the remaining compatibility error-string translations in relation_projection.py against actual callers/tests. If they are test-only historical wording, migrate those assertions to canonical compile_relation_blocks diagnostics and delete the translations; if an external compatibility obligation exists, freeze the minimal mapping explicitly. Do not reintroduce admission logic or another projection abstraction.
